mapper.select: select sku.id as sku_id, sku.sku_name, item.item_name, coalesce(sum(inventory.quantity), 0) as total_quantity, sku.min_stock, sku.max_stock, case when sku.min_stock > 0 and coalesce(sum(inventory.quantity), 0) < sku.min_stock then 'LOW' when sku.max_stock > 0 and coalesce(sum(inventory.quantity), 0) > sku.max_stock then 'HIGH' end as warning_type from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id left join wms_inventory inventory on inventory.sku_id = sku.id where sku.min_stock > 0 or sku.max_stock > 0 group by sku.id, sku.sku_name, item.item_name, sku.min_stock, sku.max_stock having warning_type is not null order by warning_type, total_quantity
